title: Variable Slope Filter Design
text: Design tunable lowpass or highpass filter coefficients, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough; {Smooth tuned filter parameters} sets the smooth filter parameters when tuning, {Smoothing factor}, {Maximum filter slope}, {Specify slope from input port} uses additional input port to specify slope, {Filter slope}, {Specify normalized cutoff frequency from input port} uses additional input port to specify normalized cutoff, {Normalized cutoff frequency}, {Specify filter type from input port} uses additional input port to specify filter, {Filter type} sets the type of filter, {Output data type} sets the data type of output, {Sample time} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Fc
ports.summary: Normalized cutoff frequency scalar in range [0,1]

params.name: Smooth tuned filter parameters
params.values: Smooth filter parameters when tuning off (default) | on

params.name: Smoothing factor
params.values: Smoothing factor for tuned parameters 0.6 (default) | scalar in range [0,1)

params.name: Maximum filter slope
params.values: Maximum filter slope (dB/octave) 12 (default) | scalar in range [0,48]

params.name: Specify slope from input port
params.values: Use additional input port to specify slope off (default) | on

params.name: Specify normalized cutoff frequency from input port
params.values: Use additional input port to specify normalized cutoff frequency off (default) | on

params.name: Normalized cutoff frequency
params.values: Normalized cutoff frequency 0.1 (default) | scalar in range [0,1]

params.name: Specify filter type from input port
params.values: Use additional input port to specify filter type off (default) | on

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of output coefficients double (default) | single

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time of block -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Specify type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
